remarks: Bright, stylish, and commuter-friendly - 31 Woodridge Drive S delivers Stamford living with a modern edge. Behind custom double entry doors, an open, sunlit layout connects a granite kitchen with island seating, 3 year old stainless appliances, and gas cooking to a spacious living area with a classic fireplace and oversized windows. French doors lead to a large, completely renovated private deck and that overlooks the spacious fenced yard, perfect for hanging out, entertaining, or letting your dog roam. Two bedrooms and a spa-inspired bath featuring a deep soaking tub complete the main level, where hardwood floors and clean lines keep things fresh and timeless. The lower level adds flexibility - great for guests, a home office, or a creative studio - with its own living space. Previous owner used lower level as a mother/daughter. Extras include 2 year old central air, a storage shed, and off-street parking. All this just minutes to Metro-North, downtown Stamford, and an easy shot to NYC - the best of suburban ease with an urban vibe.
